method.scope: Prebuilt mathematical inputs; public API call; no parsing, JSON, rendering or validation timing
method.comparison: MathForge automatic evidence production and independent verification included; SymPy value computation only
method.cache_reset: SymPy core cache, CRootOf cache and factor_cache cleared before each reset sample, outside timing; not cold process startup
method.warm_cache: One untimed priming call immediately before each measured warm call
method.gc: Collection before each call; cyclic GC disabled only during timed call; one result retained then validated and discarded
method.ordering: Fresh sequential process per round; deterministic shuffled cases and interleaved backend order for every repetition
method.validation: Every output checked exactly; MathForge complete exact value + verified labels required; independent re-verification during warmup
method.aggregation: Median of all per-call samples; raw samples, p95 and per-round medians retained; wall clock is non-gating
